## `Drivers save hundreds* when switching to Mercury Insurance` form (in the page)

- **`Please enter a valid Zip Code` / `Zip Code` / `Enter Zip Code`**: `text field`. In `HomeElements` as `PLEASE_ENTER_A_VALID_ZIP_INPUT`: `enter().pleaseEnterAValidZip(...)`.
- **`Get a Quote`**: `button`. In `HomeElements` as `GET_A_QUOTE_BUTTON`: `click().getAQuote()`.

## In the page

- **`Resume a Previous Quote`**: `button`. In `HomeElements` as `RESUME_A_PREVIOUS_QUOTE_BUTTON`: `click().resumeAPreviousQuote()`.
- **`Previous quote` / `❮`**: `button`. In `HomeElements` as `PREVIOUS_QUOTE_BUTTON`: `click().previousQuote()`.
- **`Next quote` / `❯`**: `button`. In `HomeElements` as `NEXT_QUOTE_BUTTON`: `click().nextQuote()`.
